authorization: User requests sustained testing with more evidence and interpretation before a final report; this supersedes the previous package's six-run stop for new isolated experiments.
objective: Disentangle mean approximation, spatial second moments, training randomness, observation support and precision, then test whether matched perturbation training reduces the residual sensitivity.

data.test: No new use of historical test
data.contract: Keep original GT tracks, filtered K7 inputs, labels and train/validation split for primary comparisons

factorial.output_scales: Compose previous train-only frozen per-slot scales; no new validation calibration
factorial.selection: Final epoch 60 for every run; no early stopping or best-validation choice. Old runs remain separate historical results.

paired_diagnostics.seed_protocol: Per cluster SHA256(sequence,packed_row,replicate); half and quarter nested within replicate
paired_diagnostics.grouping: Retained point count, original shape, sequence; support >=100 rows, >=3 sequences, both labels; report point-count x shape intersections when supported
paired_diagnostics.interpretation: Development sensitivity, not calibrated physical occlusion, new independent data, or proof of robustness to all radar shifts

precision.order: mean reciprocal bits, spatial-moment reciprocal bits
precision.rules: Compare matched frozen weights. Low precision is accepted as a numerical candidate only if all five seeds and supported groups pass; hardware cost remains unmeasured.

sparse_audit.context: Up to six preceding original retained >=3-point observations of the same sensor/GT track plus the current 1/2-point observation; rejected observations do not enter history
sparse_audit.control: Every retained K7 observation must reproduce cached primary features
sparse_audit.interpretation: New exploratory coverage audit on familiar validation sequences, no sparse-data retraining and no independent test claim

augmentation.trigger: After factorial evaluation, run if at least 4 of 5 proxy seeds lose >=1 F1 percentage point under uniform_quarter_0 or central_half versus clean
augmentation.draws: One visit per original training row per epoch, choose view with separate fixed-seed RNG; same row permutations and initial seeds as clean training
augmentation.normalization_and_calibration: Train-only mixture mean/std and fixed train-only calibration views; same previously frozen output scales
augmentation.purpose: Test representation x training-distribution effects; no teacher, architecture, loss-family or hyperparameter search

decision: Report all five seeds, all predefined conditions, harmonic F1 components, harm/repair, natural and supported intersecting groups. Separate main effects and interaction from correlated approximations. Stop on mismatches or budgets; do not add seeds/variants to rescue a hypothesis. Phase B is the only permitted adaptive training stage and its selection is disclosed.
review: Single-executor pre-run review. Larger fixed-duration factorial resolves old early-stop confounding; fixed-weight precision isolates arithmetic; sparse single and retained-context views distinguish missing coverage from K7 support. Validation remains exploratory. A beneficial CPU model is not evidence of FPGA timing/energy benefit.
